nodes.name: export_policy.sh
nodes.docString: Shell script that exports a PI0.5 deploy bundle from a finished training run. Sets up PYTHONPATH (common/src, train/src, deploy/src, third_party/lerobot/src), then invokes `python -m pi05.train.cli.export_bundle --config train/config/lora.yaml`. Supports env overrides for RUN_DIR, ADAPTER_DIR, OUTPUT_DIR, and OVERWRITE.

nodes.name: prepare_dataset.sh
nodes.docString: Shell script that wraps tools/mcap_to_lerobot_v3.py to convert ROS2 MCAP recordings into LeRobot v3 datasets. Supports two modes: 'mcap' (single file) and 'mcap-dir' (directory). Discovers the converter script via a 3-tier path search. Configurable via env vars OUT_DIR, REPO_ID, TASK_NAME, FPS, and CONVERTER_SCRIPT.

nodes.name: smoke_test.py
nodes.docString: End-to-end smoke test for the Pi0.5 LoRA training stack. Validates: (1) model build with LoRA adapters, (2) mock LeRobot-style batch creation, (3) forward pass with finite loss, (4) backward pass with non-zero LoRA gradients. Falls back to synthetic language tokens if the official LeRobot PI0.5 preprocessor is unavailable.

nodes.name: test_dataloader.py
nodes.docString: Sanity-check script for the Pi0.5 LeRobot dataloader. Loads one batch from a real dataset, configures Pi05LeRobotDataset with state/action normalizers, and prints tensor shapes, dtypes, and value ranges for cameras, 26D state, and 14D action chunks.

nodes.name: train_lora.sh
nodes.docString: Shell script that launches Pi0.5 LoRA fine-tuning. Sets PYTHONPATH (common/src, train/src, deploy/src, third_party/lerobot/src), enables PYTHONNOUSERSITE to prevent conda env shadowing, parses --config override, and invokes `python -m pi05.train.cli.train --config <path>`. Passes extra positional args through to the training CLI.

nodes.name: pi05.train.cli.export_bundle
nodes.docString: Python CLI module that bundles a trained LoRA checkpoint into a deployable artifact. Invoked by export_policy.sh via `python -m pi05.train.cli.export_bundle`.

nodes.name: pi05.train.cli.train
nodes.docString: Python CLI module for the Pi0.5 LoRA fine-tuning engine. Invoked by train_lora.sh via `python -m pi05.train.cli.train`.

nodes.name: pi05.common.model.builder
nodes.docString: Model builder module providing build_pi05_with_lora() used by smoke_test.py to construct the PI0.5 model with LoRA adapters.

nodes.name: pi05.common.data.normalization
nodes.docString: Normalization module providing build_state_action_normalizers() used by test_dataloader.py to compute q99.5 fixed-scale norm statistics.

nodes.name: pi05.train.data.dataset
nodes.docString: Dataset module providing Pi05LeRobotDataset class used by test_dataloader.py to wrap LeRobot datasets for Pi0.5 training.

nodes.name: lerobot.policies.pi05.processor_pi05
nodes.docString: LeRobot module providing make_pi05_pre_post_processors() for PI0.5 task tokenization. Used by smoke_test.py in official tokenizer path.

nodes.name: lerobot.utils.constants
nodes.docString: LeRobot constants module providing OBS_LANGUAGE_TOKENS and OBS_LANGUAGE_ATTENTION_MASK used by smoke_test.py for synthetic token fallback.

nodes.name: mcap_to_lerobot_v3.py
nodes.docString: Octopus ROS2 .mcap to LeRobot v3 dataset converter (action 14D, state 26D, inspire_hand_v1 tactile). Invoked by prepare_dataset.sh as the core conversion tool.

nodes.name: lora.yaml
nodes.docString: LoRA fine-tuning YAML configuration. Referenced by export_policy.sh, smoke_test.py, and train_lora.sh as the default training/export config.

nodes.name: build_pi05_with_lora
nodes.docString: Imported from pi05.common.model.builder. Constructs PI0.5 model with LoRA adapters from config dict and optional pretrained path. Called at line 206 in main().

nodes.name: make_mock_batch
nodes.docString: Creates a synthetic LeRobot-style batch with random tensors: observation.state (batch_size x state_dim), action (batch_size x chunk_size x action_dim), task strings, and observation.images.{camera} (batch_size x 3 x 224 x 224).

nodes.name: prepare_model_batch
nodes.docString: Converts raw mock batch into PI0.5 training batch. Attempts official LeRobot preprocessor via make_pi05_pre_post_processors; falls back to synthetic OBS_LANGUAGE_TOKENS and OBS_LANGUAGE_ATTENTION_MASK tensors.

nodes.name: _get_policy_config
nodes.docString: Introspects the model to locate the PI0.5 policy config by checking model.pi05_policy_config, then traversing model, base_model, and base_model.model for a .config attribute.

nodes.name: find_lora_gradient
nodes.docString: Iterates model named_parameters to find one LoRA parameter (name containing 'lora_') with requires_grad=True and non-None grad tensor.

nodes.name: load_yaml
nodes.docString: Opens a YAML path, calls yaml.safe_load, and validates the root is a mapping.

nodes.name: parse_args
nodes.docString: Argparse setup for smoke test: config path (default train/config/lora.yaml), pretrained-path, batch-size, chunk-size, state-dim (26), action-dim (14), device (cuda/cpu), tokenizer-mode (auto/official/synthetic).

nodes.name: main
nodes.docString: Entry point. Parses args, loads YAML config, builds LoRA model via build_pi05_with_lora(), creates mock batch, runs forward pass validating finite loss, runs backward pass validating non-zero LoRA gradients.

nodes.name: _require_torch
nodes.docString: Raises ModuleNotFoundError if torch is None (import failed). Called at start of main().

nodes.name: _bootstrap_import_paths
nodes.docString: Inserts common/src, train/src, and third_party/lerobot/src into sys.path at module load time.

nodes.name: Pi05LeRobotDataset
nodes.docString: Imported from pi05.train.data.dataset. LeRobot dataset wrapper configured with chunk_size, color jitter, image_size, state_dim, action_dim, cameras, and optional normalizers.

nodes.name: build_state_action_normalizers
nodes.docString: Imported from pi05.common.data.normalization. Computes q99.5 fixed-scale normalizers for state (26D) and action (14D) from a LeRobot dataset.

nodes.name: describe_tensor
nodes.docString: Prints name, shape tuple, dtype, min, and max for a given torch.Tensor.

nodes.name: parse_args
nodes.docString: Argparse setup: dataset-path, chunk-size (30), batch-size (4), num-workers (2), disable-color-jitter, image-size (224), state-dim (26), action-dim (14), cameras (top left_wrist right_wrist).

nodes.name: main
nodes.docString: Entry point. Creates Pi05LeRobotDataset with normalizers, wraps in DataLoader with pin_memory, iterates one batch, prints describe_tensor for each camera image, state, and action_chunk.

nodes.name: OBS_LANGUAGE_TOKENS
nodes.docString: LeRobot constant key used by smoke_test.py to inject synthetic language token tensors into the model batch during fallback mode.

nodes.name: OBS_LANGUAGE_ATTENTION_MASK
nodes.docString: LeRobot constant key used by smoke_test.py to inject synthetic attention mask tensors into the model batch during fallback mode.

nodes.name: make_pi05_pre_post_processors
nodes.docString: LeRobot factory that creates PI0.5 preprocessor and postprocessor for task tokenization. Used by smoke_test.py prepare_model_batch() in official/preferred tokenizer path.

nodes.name: shared_pythonpath_bootstrap
nodes.docString: Repeated PYTHONPATH construction pattern across export_policy.sh and train_lora.sh: adds PROJECT_DIR/common/src, train/src, deploy/src, then discovers third_party/lerobot/src via 3-tier search (project/parent/grandparent).

nodes.name: 3tier_path_search
nodes.docString: Discovery pattern used by export_policy.sh (for lerobot src) and prepare_dataset.sh (for mcap_to_lerobot_v3.py): checks PROJECT_DIR, PROJECT_DIR/.., PROJECT_DIR/../.. for the target, picks the first match.

nodes.name: state_26d_action_14d_schema
nodes.docString: Canonical Pi0.5 tensor dimensions: state=26D (proprioception), action=14D (bimanual dexterous hand control). Enforced by smoke_test.py (--state-dim 26, --action-dim 14), test_dataloader.py (--state-dim 26, --action-dim 14), and the MCAP converter.

nodes.name: default_cameras
nodes.docString: Default camera tuple (top, left_wrist, right_wrist) shared by smoke_test.py (line 187) and test_dataloader.py (line 66). Used for image observation keys in model batch.

nodes.name: dataset_preparation
nodes.docString: First step in the PI0.5 pipeline: convert raw MCAP recordings to LeRobot dataset via prepare_dataset.sh → mcap_to_lerobot_v3.py.

nodes.name: lora_training
nodes.docString: Second step in the PI0.5 pipeline: fine-tune LoRA adapters via train_lora.sh → pi05.train.cli.train.

nodes.name: bundle_export
nodes.docString: Third step in the PI0.5 pipeline: export trained LoRA weights into a deploy bundle via export_policy.sh → pi05.train.cli.export_bundle.
